title: Video
slide_intent: Teach producers to separate identifying the speaker, signing the footage and closing the piece. These choices help a viewer understand who is talking and whose communication they are watching.
strategic_value: Slack can make interview footage recognizable while giving the speaker room to lead. The lower third supplies context, and the watermark can identify the brand with a smaller visual presence.
demonstration: The page pairs three production notes with two interview stills. The first still carries a name and role at lower left. The second places a Slack watermark at upper left. Copy also specifies a logo ending slate.
practical_value: Use the speaker’s name and title for the lower third, reserve the upper-left position for a watermark, and plan a logo ending. The two frames demonstrate placement and hierarchy.

content_islands.name: Page heading
content_islands.spec: Set Video as the heading above a horizontal rule.

content_islands.name: Production notes
content_islands.spec: Stack three short paragraphs at left. Use bold lead-ins for lower thirds, ending slates and watermarks. Specify Larsseit Bold for the name and Slack Circular Book for the title, an 80% opaque lower-third background, and a 50% opaque watermark.

content_islands.name: Lower-third specimen
content_islands.spec: In the upper-right interview frame, place the subject to the right and a rectangular nameplate at lower left. Give the name greater typographic emphasis than the role.

content_islands.name: Watermark specimen
content_islands.spec: Stack the second frame directly below the first. Center the speaker against the pink background and place a pale Slack mark near the upper-left corner.

content_islands.name: Running footer
content_islands.spec: Place the folio, book title and section name below the bottom rule.
